entries.name: Copper Body
entries.trial_text: Stumps and stones on Willow Path West: three minutes of charging beasts without falling below half your HP.
entries.gift_text: +5% Physical Defense. Body techniques may spend HP when your QI runs short.

entries.name: Iron Body
entries.trial_text: Pilgrim Stairs: break five Stone Guardians in a single run before the incense burns down.

entries.name: Jade Body
entries.trial_text: The pole trial (Sword Court or East Terrace): ninety seconds on the plum-blossom poles. Touch the ground for more than two seconds and it is over.

entries.name: Gold Body
entries.trial_text: The Lightning Scar in the Azure Expanse: three minutes under the storm among the thunderhorns, never below half your HP.
